title: Key West Sailing & Snorkeling: A Reef Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join us for a snorkel adventure to the only living coral reef in North America. We have several fantastic reefs to choose from on both the north and south sides of Key West, each offering a unique experience. It’s about an hour trip out to the reef, we will have you there for an hour and then a one hour journey back to our dock. We will provide instruction on how to use the equipment but recommend that you are comfortable in water over your head and that you have the ability to swim.
*We provide quality sanitized mask, snorkel, fins and flotation vest
*Professional guidance and instruction on how to use provided gear
*Fresh water hose available to rinse off after snorkeling
*Complimentary beverages to include water, soda, white wine, a selection of craft beers, margaritas, and champagne
*Floridays takes a limited number of guests so that we may provide you with the ultimate in enjoyment and service
